module.label: Voice & Communications
module.description: Calls, SMS/MMS and WhatsApp conversations connected to CRM records, with provider-neutral adapters, consent and channel policy.

page.title: Voice & Communications
page.subtitle: Provider health, channel policy and webhook processing for calls and messages.
page.loadFailed: The module diagnostics could not be loaded.
page.loadFailedHint: Check that migration 051 is applied and that you hold the module's administrative capability.
page.noAccounts: No provider account is configured. Every send and call is refused until one exists.
page.noEvents: No provider callback has been recorded yet.

settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.failedHint: The module refused the document as a whole. Correct the value named above; nothing was stored.
settings.featuresHint: Every feature starts off; an operation whose channel is off is refused.
settings.providerHint: Which account calls and messages use by default.
settings.defaultAccountHint: Empty means no default: every operation must name an account and is refused when it does not.
settings.policyHint: Applied before every send and call.
settings.defaultRegionHint: Two-letter ISO code applied to a national phone number.
settings.whatsappWindowHoursHint: Outside the window a free-form message needs an approved template.
settings.maxMessageLengthHint: Longer bodies are refused and the composer warns.
settings.maxSendsPerMinuteHint: 0 means the provider's own limit applies.
settings.replayWindowSecondsHint: A callback whose timestamp is further away is refused.
settings.mediaHint: How provider recordings are fetched and kept.
settings.fetchModeHint: Off keeps the provider reference only; private storage downloads the bytes.
settings.allowedHostsHint: Only these hostnames may be fetched. Empty refuses every fetch in production.
settings.allowLoopbackHint: Development only; never enable this on a live deployment.
settings.noticeRequiredHint: Store the operator-facing notice; the current build returns it but does not enforce it.
settings.aiHint: Drafts only; a human still sends or acts.
settings.connectionKeyHint: Names the platform's AI gateway connection.
settings.modelHint: The model the gateway uses for summaries and replies.
settings.maxTranscriptCharsHint: The redacted transcript is truncated before it reaches the model.
settings.accountsHint: Accounts and sender numbers save immediately. A stored credential or webhook secret is never shown again.
settings.accountKeyHint: Use letters, digits, '_' or '-'; the key cannot be changed later.
settings.noAdapters: No adapter in this deployment can be configured.
settings.capabilitiesHint: Only what the adapter declares; the server refuses a capability it does not implement.
settings.capabilityGap: Some grants are not implemented by the adapter
settings.configHint: Non-secret settings only; a key that looks like a credential is refused.
settings.configInvalid: Enter a JSON object, for example {}.
settings.secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
settings.secretWriteOnly: Credentials and webhook secrets are write-only; the server never returns a stored value.
settings.accountDeleteConfirm: Remove account {key}? Its sender numbers are removed with it.
settings.accountFailed: The provider account could not be saved.
settings.endpointsHint: An outbound call needs an active voice endpoint; inbound callbacks match on these numbers.
settings.noEndpoints: No sender number is registered for this account.
settings.endpointFailed: The sender number could not be saved.

inbox.callsHint: Select a call to see its recordings and transcript.
inbox.noMessages: This conversation has no messages yet.
inbox.noCalls: No call has been recorded yet.
inbox.notePlaceholder: Write an internal note (never sent to the customer)…
inbox.internalNoteHint: An internal note is stored for agents only and is structurally unable to be sent.
inbox.sendFailedGeneric: The message could not be sent.
inbox.renderFailed: The snippet could not be rendered.
inbox.handoffFailed: The Case could not be created.
inbox.mediaFailed: The recording could not be loaded.
inbox.noRecordings: No recording is available for this call.
inbox.noTranscript: No transcript has been requested for this call.
inbox.callPlaced: The call was placed through the configured provider.
inbox.callFailedGeneric: The call could not be placed.
